{{legend|#CC2F4A|60–70%}} {{col-end}} }} {{Elections in Connecticut}} The '''2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut''' were held on November 5, 2024, to elect the five [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. representatives]] from the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[Connecticut]], one from each of the state's five [[Connecticut's congressional districts|congressional districts]]. The elections coincided with the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]], [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, [[2024 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]], and various [[2024 United States elections|state and local elections]].
